🍬 CANDY SHOP is open, and the man behind the decks is sweeter than anything in the bag. DJ Ralphy Ray takes over Azucar this Friday for the first full dose of our newest weekly obsession. Bass that rattles your ribs, beats that melt like sugar on your tongue, and a room full of people who already know this is about to be THE Friday habit in Pasco. Curls, lollipops, candy-colored lights — the whole vibe is dipped in sugar rush energy. Pull up, get a taste, and don't be surprised if you're already planning next Friday before this one's even over. 🍭💥

📅 Friday, October 23 | Doors 9PM–2AM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 $5 Cover
🔞 18+ to party, 21+ to drink

🍭 Sweet tooth? Azucar's got the cure. CANDY SHOP drops a brand new Skittles flight flavor every single week, and this Friday's batch is calling your name. Shot after shot of color, sugar, and straight-up chaos in the best way possible. Plus — ladies, you're in free before 11PM, so there's zero excuse to miss this one. $5 cover for everybody else, doors swing open at 9PM and don't stop till 2AM. This is the kind of night that turns into the story you tell all week. Candy-coated cocktails, a room buzzing with energy, and a vibe too good to skip. Grab your crew, get here early, and taste the flavor of the week before it's gone. 🍬🔥
